name: MSK infections overview
title: Musculoskeletal infections by depth: hand cellulitis (antibiotics) versus closed-space hand infections (incision and drainage), joint infections beyond the usual staphylococcus and streptococcus (gonococcal, Lyme, tuberculous, several joints meaning endocarditis), osteomyelitis including vertebral osteomyelitis, and the diabetic foot; deeper infections need drainage or debridement as well as antibiotics

root.title: Hand, joint, bone or diabetic foot: HOW DEEP is it, and does it need a knife as well as antibiotics?
lines: antibiotics alone will NOT save you: pus in a closed space, a joint or dead bone needs drainage or debridement
one hot joint with Staphylococcus or streptococcus: see the ACUTE MONOARTHRITIS chart

groups.title: BONE and the diabetic foot
lines: blood supply, chronicity and debridement decide cure

head: h
Deep (closed-space) infection
palm side, fingertip, around joints
clue: • human, fist fight, knuckle: Eikenella corrodens
inv: • held flexed · tender along the sheath

head: h
Gonococcal, Lyme, tuberculous
large-joint monoarthritis (or oligo)
inv: Match the test to the bug
• gonococcus: urine, rectal, throat nucleic acid test or culture + blood culture (joint fluid + in only 50%)
• Lyme: serology · tuberculosis: joint fluid for acid-fast bacilli
tx: • tuberculosis: RIPE four-drug therapy, 9 months–1 year

head: h
Osteomyelitis
blood-borne: spine, children
contiguous: diabetic foot, trauma, surgery
clue: • often afebrile · people who inject drugs
S. aureus always · Salmonella in sickle cell · Kingella
inv: • tagged white cell scan takes 2 days

head: h
Diabetic foot infection
neuropathy + poor blood supply
clue: A wound is NOT always infected
• swab any wound and bacteria grow
• smelly? probe to bone? blood supply?
inv: 1 · Bloods; swab only a good deep specimen
blood count, electrolytes, creatinine, C-reactive protein
tx: • offload, debride, call ortho or vascular

panels.title: Prosthetic joint infection
items: HIGH index of suspicion · less virulent organisms (coagulase-negative staphylococci, Cutibacterium acnes)
managed by the orthopedic surgeon + infectious diseases

panels.title: Viral polyarthritis
items: parvovirus B19 (with anemia) · chikungunya, Zika, dengue (travel) · hepatitis B, C, HIV
